notes: Sheet is drawn rotated (page top is west, page right is north): Vernon along the top, Renner down the left side, W. Clifton Av along the bottom, Conroy and Emming running SSE across the sheet. Names printed without suffix (RENNER, CONROY, EMMING) written with 'Street'; VERNON ST., HAMBURG ST., GUY ST., WHEELER ST. as printed; HASTINGS (NOT OPEN) written Hastings Street. Crossings on the boundary streets are picked even where they also appear on neighbours: Vernon/Renner and Hamburg/Renner (also on 229), the two Vernon/Conroy T's, Vernon/Emming and Guy/Emming (also on 239, where Vernon/Conroy is (4790,6851)/(5192,6855), Vernon/Emming (5190,5372), Guy/Emming (5888,5370)), Wheeler/Emming and Emming/Clifton (also on 240). Vernon jogs at Conroy: the 20' west part meets Conroy ~355 px (page) north of the 40' east part, so two T points. Guy and Wheeler are only stubs east of Emming in the 240 margin. The unnamed N-S way '?' runs from the rear lot line of the Vernon lots south between the Renner lots and the hillside, as a 16' alley (centre x~1425) down to y~5300, then jogs east into a 17' street (centre x~1683) that ends at Clifton's bend; Hamburg St ends at it (T), and a ~12 ft unnamed strip continues from Hamburg's end ENE to Hastings (alleys). No name is printed for it here or on 231. Hastings (40', NOT OPEN) runs from the rear lot line SSE to Clifton. The area between Hastings and Conroy is lettered HILLSIDE. Water pipes and lot lines ignored.
